name: Affinity
label: Affinity — relationship CRM (API v2 2026-07-15 + v1 writes)
description: Official Affinity API at https://api.affinity.co. Reads/search use v2 (X-Affinity-Api-Version 2026-07-15). Person/organization CRUD and list-entry create/delete use v1 paths because v2 is not at write parity. Bearer api_key (v1 also accepts Bearer). Relationship data is sensitive — minimize fieldIds. Customer owns the Affinity workspace. api_key is never logged. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Set operation to override config.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT catalog verb.

schema.label: first_name
schema.description: Person first name for person.create/update. Example: Ada.

schema.label: last_name
schema.description: Person last name for person.create/update. Example: Lovelace.

schema.label: emails
schema.description: Email strings for person.create/update. JSON array. Example: ["ada@example.com"].

schema.label: organization_ids
schema.description: Organization ids to attach on person.create/update. JSON array of integers.

schema.label: personId
schema.description: Affinity person id.

schema.label: fieldIds
schema.description: Without fieldIds, v2 returns no field data.

schema.label: fieldTypes
schema.description: Per-operation field `fieldTypes`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: cursor
schema.description: Per-operation field `cursor`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: Per-operation field `limit`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: ids
schema.description: Per-operation field `ids`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Organization name for organization.create/update. Example: Analytical Engines.

schema.label: person_ids
schema.description: Person ids to attach on organization.create/update. JSON array of integers.

schema.label: organizationId
schema.description: Organization / v2 company id.

schema.label: listId
schema.description: List id.

schema.label: entity_id
schema.description: Person, organization, or opportunity id for listEntry.create.

schema.label: listEntryId
schema.description: List-entry id.

schema.label: domain
schema.description: Organization domain for organization.create/update. Example: example.com.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream status code.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON body. Minimize retained PII.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: person.create | person.get | person.list | person.update | person.delete | organization.create | organization.get | organization.list | organization.update | organization.delete | list.get | list.list | listEntry.create | listEntry.get | listEntry.list | listEntry.delete.

configurationParameters.label: Api Version
configurationParameters.description: Documented X-Affinity-Api-Version for v2 (current stable 2026-07-15). Sent as extraHeaders `{api_version}` on every request. Override per instance or per INPUT. https://developer.affinity.co/pages/external-api-v2/versioning

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: Affinity API key (Settings → Manage Apps). Authorization: Bearer. v1 also accepts Basic empty-user. Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
